description: Longitudinal SEM skill for latent growth and change. Collects wave structure, checks whether a growth/change model is identified, fits an initial linear growth or latent change specification, and reports fit plus trajectory parameters with a recommendation block. Trigger when the user asks for latent growth models, growth curves in SEM, latent change score models, longitudinal latent trajectories, growth curve modeling, LGM, LCSM, trajectory analysis, or change over time in SEM. Does not handle cross- sectional CFA (use vera-data-cfa-reviewing) or non-longitudinal structural models (use vera-data-path-reviewing).
